name: MonarchAttachmentChip
title: AttachmentChip
summary: A compact chip for one attached file: the type icon, the name, the size, upload progress or failure, and remove and retry buttons.
whenToUse: For files attached to a message, a form or a ticket reply, alone or in a list, while they upload and after.
whenNotToUse: For a file in a file browser with a preview, use a file card or MonarchFilePreview. For a tag that is not a file, use MonarchTag.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAttachmentChip(name: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, status: MonarchUploadStatus = MonarchUploadStatus.Done, enabled: Boolean = true, sizeBytes: Long? = null, contentType: String? = null, progress: Float? = null, errorMessage: String? = null, onOpen: (() -> Unit)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onRemove: (() -> Unit)? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, retryIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAttachmentChipLabels = MonarchAttachmentChipLabels())
enum class MonarchUploadStatus { Queued, Uploading, Done, Failed, Cancelled; val active: Boolean }

class MonarchAttachmentChipLabels(remove: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, retry: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, uploading: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, queued: String? = null, failed: String? = null, cancelled: String? = null, removeText: String? = null, retryText: String? = null)

options.name: name
options.description: The file name; long names are shortened in the middle.

options.name: status
options.description: Queued, Uploading, Done, Failed or Cancelled.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Disables the retry and remove buttons, for example while the message is sending.

options.name: sizeBytes
options.description: The size in bytes, shown once uploaded in the user's units.

options.name: contentType
options.description: The MIME type; with the name it picks the type icon.

options.name: progress
options.description: The uploaded fraction from 0 to 1 while uploading. null shows a moving bar and no percentage.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Why the upload failed, shown instead of "Upload failed".

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Opens the file once uploaded; the name becomes a button. The app opens the file.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds a retry button to a failed upload.

options.name: icon
options.description: Replaces the type icon, for example with a thumbnail. Decorative.

options.name: retryIcon
options.description: The icon of the retry button; without it the button shows the word "Retry".

options.name: removeIcon
options.description: The icon of the remove button; without it the button shows the word "Remove".

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings monarch_attachmentchip_*.

states.name: done
states.description: The size under the name; with onOpen the name is an underlined link-coloured button.

states.name: uploading
states.description: The percentage under the name and a progress bar named "Uploading report.pdf"; a moving bar without progress.

states.name: failed
states.description: The subtle danger fill and border, the error in danger text (announced) and the retry button.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The retry and remove buttons are disabled.

appearance: A bordered row with medium rounded corners on the surface color and the default border; a failed upload takes the subtle danger fill and the danger border. The name is label text, the line under it muted caption text (strong danger for a failure). The progress bar is MonarchProgress in the accent color. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map names InputChip; an input chip is one touch target, and this chip has up to three (open, retry, remove) and a second line, so it is a bordered Row with Material 3 IconButtons and MonarchButtons. The web accepts any thumbnail as the icon, as the icon slot does here. The web retry and close glyphs are not bundled: with retryIcon and removeIcon the buttons are icon buttons, without them they show a word. The web href and download become onOpen, because components do not open files. Progress is a fraction from 0 to 1, as in MonarchProgress, where the web takes 0 to 100. The web marks the failure as an alert; here it is a polite live region. The parity map lists tag as a dependency; MonarchTag is not used, as on iOS. iOS shares the name and the statuses.
accessibility: The name and the line under it are one TalkBack element; TalkBack reads the whole name even when it is shortened.
With onOpen that element is a button with a touch target of at least 48dp; the link state is shown by an underline as well as the color.
The retry and remove buttons are separate elements named after the file, "Retry budget.xlsx" and "Remove budget.xlsx", each with a 48dp touch target.
The progress bar is named "Uploading photo.jpg" and exposes its range.
The failure line is a polite live region, so a failure is announced.
The type icon and the button icons are hidden from TalkBack.
edgeCases: A long name stays on one line, shortened in the middle, so the extension stays visible.
onOpen is ignored until the upload is done.
progress outside 0 to 1 is limited; NaN shows a moving bar.
